name: Bomb Jack Beer Edition
summary: Bomb Jack Beer Edition is an arcade home brew port of the classic Tecmo game released in 1984. Take control of Jack and collect the lit bombs in order. If you collect all bombs in order you get a special bonus. Get enough bonuses and you'll be taken to the special rounds that were exclusively created for the Amiga.
